sources.beginner: pl_n and bit dp by hand (beginner/m02/l02:19 log2, m04/l02:9 square law); pipe/annulus/pump need the engine on the capstone mud, which no NextGen panel accepts (panels/hydraulics/*Explorer.jsx select only the fixture muds) and the course never points at the Suite Hydraulics Studio (kPa toFixed(0/1)).
sources.intermediate: Only the mud-independent annular velocity is reachable (CleaningExplorer.jsx:118, fmt 6, flow rate editable); ECD, transport ratio, concentration and the 0.80 solve need the capstone mud, which no panel accepts.
sources.advanced: Every field needs surge/swab on the capstone mud; SurgeExplorer.jsx offers trip speed and window inputs but only the fixture muds; Suite SurgeSwabTab prints EMW at 0.5 m/s only (g/cc toFixed(3)) and safe speed toFixed(2).

fields.evidence: n = log2(theta600/theta300) is printed in l02:19; log2(52/33) = 0.656046 at calculator precision, tol 5e-7 is fine for a full-precision hand calc.
fields.notes: A learner using the field formula 3.32 log10 gets 0.65560 and fails, but the course teaches log2 explicitly. Suite MudRheologyTab prints n.toFixed(3) (src/pages/apps/HydraulicsStudio/components/MudRheologyTab.jsx:93), unusable at this tol.

fields.recommendation: Teach the yield rule in l04 (one line) so the m06 exercise "compute fields 1 and 2 by hand" is possible; otherwise widen tol to 0.005 for the Suite MudRheologyTab tauYPa.toFixed(2).

fields.recommendation: Add a "Capstone mud" / custom dial-readings + density input to the three NextGen panels (they already format at 4 to 8 decimals); without it these fields are ungradable by a learner. Alternative is teaching the full local power-law march by hand, which is an engine-only element-by-element calculation.
fields.evidence: NextGen panels only offer the four fixture cases (CASE_OPTIONS = CASES.map(...), e.g. src/components/course/panels/hydraulics/RheologyExplorer.jsx:23,31); the engine takes `over.fann`/`over.densityKgM3` (src/components/course/panels/hydraulics/hydraulicsLab.js:101, used by capstoneValues at :270) but no panel exposes it, so the capstone mud 52/33/6/5 at 1320 cannot be run. The Suite Hydraulics Studio is never mentioned by the course, would need the fixture survey rebuilt by hand, and prints too coarsely anyway: Suite prints only per-element dP in kPa toFixed(1) (src/pages/apps/HydraulicsStudio/components/HydraulicsTab.jsx:124) and no pipe total. Pipe loss is a local power-law march over the collars/HWDP/DP elements, not a hand formula.
